answer: Bind each epoch's reward to proof-of-unique-work: every identity must submit freshly reasoned analysis plus solve a memory-hard puzzle keyed to its own pubkey and the epoch seed, so no two keys share a solution. The ledger fingerprints answer content and drops near-duplicates before any peer attests, so a clone farm can't press one ivory-smooth essay across a thousand keys, nor let one plume of cached compute drift between them; each fake clears the reef of cognition alone. Cost: 1000 clones pay 1000x irreducible compute; 1000 chains/epoch (linear per head, none amortizes).
